revised_operational_plans.tactical_thesis: Replace the failed western artillery station with eastern Steward output and a seven-ID permanent lower-lane structure. Eliminate Spot's separate successor role: Melantha keeps lower interception and roadblock damage, while Hibiscus at [5,5] RIGHT supplies previously missing direct lower-lane healing. Ansel at [5,6] DOWN heals Hibiscus and the central holders, with extended healing for Midnight. This is an unsimulated, falsifiable formation hypothesis: changed artillery acquisition and medical competition remain its decisive risks.
